description: This file contains unit tests for the capsule parsing functionality in the quiche library, including tests for serialization, deserialization, handling multiple capsules, partial reads, and error conditions.

classes.name: CapsuleParserPeer
classes.description: Provides access to the buffered data of a CapsuleParser instance for testing.

classes.name: MockCapsuleParserVisitor
classes.description: Mock implementation of CapsuleParser::Visitor for testing capsule parsing callbacks.

classes.name: CapsuleTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for capsule parsing tests, including validation and serialization helpers.

methods.name: ValidateParserIsEmpty
methods.description: Checks that the parser has no remaining buffered data and no parse failures.

methods.name: TestSerialization
methods.description: Serializes a capsule and compares the output to expected bytes.
